## Featured products

## New Online Training!

We are excited to release our first online, interactive, self-paced training course, ePairing I.
This course will introduce and guide you through concepts and best practices for production planning
in Jeppesen Crew Pairing (JCP). Whether you are a new customer ready to dive into JCP or a current
customer looking for a refresher, this course provides easy access and significant value.
[Learn More][138]

## Customized Trip Planning, Dispatch and Fueling solutions

FliteSupport Services provides tailored, flexible trip support solutions to meet your unique
international trip planning, dispatch and fueling needs. Our 24/7 team works with you to build and
execute a plan to support worldwide operations, and augment your flight department with decades of
expertise. We fill any necessary gaps to make your operations more capable and efficient.
[Learn more][139]

## Mission critical

With today’s military air operations facing increasing budgetary constraints, spiraling costs, and
higher levels of scrutiny, you need a management support solution capable of organizing your complex
mission goals. In order to capture and exploit every ounce of capability from your resources,
assets, fuel, and time, channeling essential mission data in an optimal manner through your Air
Operation Center (AOC) isn’t optional. It’s a necessity.

flight app to make flying safer, easier, and more efficient.

flight planning, checklists, charts, weather, airport information, flight logging, document
management, hazard awareness, and more.

# Business Aviation

Maximize the efficiency and safety of your flight operation by utilizing ForeFlight's seamlessly
integrated data, software and services - all specifically designed for optimal performance and
usability.

ForeFlight provides the world’s best pilots with everything they need to keep their operations

## About Me

hardware, and game development. I'm not a full-time developer, but I'm learning and want to learn. I
can help with aviation-related projects and enjoy working at the intersection of technology and my
interests.

I've built and maintained a full ADS-B receiver setup using Docker containers, aggregating live
aircraft data and feeding it to multiple flight-tracking platforms including FlightRadar24,
FlightAware, and other major networks.

### Hardware & Aviation

I've built Stratux-style systems for my Private Pilot License training. It's a straightforward build
that anyone can do, but it's been useful for understanding aviation workflows and data usage.

### ROBLOX Development

understand how airports operate and how taxi diagrams are structured, which helps with the modeling
work.

technical problem-solving and hardware: I regularly work with and repair electronics including DJI
drones, phones, laptops, and other devices.

### Photography

the lens.

## About Me

I'm Aayan, a technically inclined developer with experience across flight tracking systems,
hardware, and game development. I'm not a full-time developer, but I'm learning and want to learn. I
can help with aviation-related projects and enjoy working at the intersection of technology and my
interests.

### Flight Tracking Systems

I've built and maintained a full ADS-B receiver setup using Docker containers, aggregating live
aircraft data and feeding it to multiple flight-tracking platforms including FlightRadar24,
FlightAware, and other major networks.

### Hardware & Aviation

I've built Stratux-style systems for my Private Pilot License training. It's a straightforward build
that anyone can do, but it's been useful for understanding aviation workflows and data usage.

### ROBLOX Development

I work with ROBLOX Studio, mainly creating basic airport layouts, taxiways, and markings. I
understand how airports operate and how taxi diagrams are structured, which helps with the modeling
work.

### Technical Skills

I'm a beginner-to-intermediate coder with experience in systems thinking. My strongest skill set is
technical problem-solving and hardware: I regularly work with and repair electronics including DJI
drones, phones, laptops, and other devices.

### Photography

I do some occasional photography with a Sony A7Riii, exploring aviation and other subjects through
the lens.

## Aireon is the pioneer of space-based automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) data for
## the aviation industry

Aireon’s one-of-a-kind ADS-B data stream is bringing unprecedented levels of safety, efficiency, and
environmental responsibility to a wide range of customers in the aviation industry, including air
navigation service providers, airlines, airport operators, airframe manufacturers, system
integrators, and military and intelligence agencies.

With its portfolio of diverse products, Aireon is enabling new levels of insight into air operations
around the globe, leading to more data-driven decision making.

[About us][41]

## Our products combine the highest quality data with valuable insights

ATS Surveillance AireonSTREAM AireonFLOW AireonINSIGHTS AireonVECTOR
[ATS Surveillance]

#### Safety-grade data for navigation

Aireon has deployed the first-of-its-kind air traffic surveillance system, and the Aireon data has
quickly become the gold-standard for ANSPs around the world to safely manage their airspaces.

[Learn more][42]
[AireonSTREAM]

#### Tailored, streaming data

AireonSTREAM provides global, gate-to-gate, surface-to-space ATS surveillance quality data, combined
with contextual flight and airspace information, including infrastructure, weather, avionics,
aircraft registry, and schedule data.

[Learn more][43]
[AireonFLOW]

#### Real-time data for traffic flow management

AireonFLOW is gate-to-gate, high- fidelity Air Traffic Services (ATS) surveillance data combined
with flight and airspace contextual information. Combined, this enhances prediction capabilities of
flow management and demand platforms.

[Learn more][44]
[AireonINSIGHTS]

#### Event-based flight information

AireonINSIGHTS family of products — including Aireon Locate — put the power of our dataset into your
hands. Whether you are a first responder needing to locate an aircraft with Aireon Locate or an
operator wanting to ensure the integrity of the GPS signal in your airspace, AireonINSIGHTS is there
for you.

[Learn more][45]
[AireonVECTOR photo]

#### Real-time GPS interference detection

AireonVECTOR is a suite of products that uses Aireon’s space-based ADS-B data to detect and
visualize GPS interference—such as jamming and spoofing—in real time. By generating a
GPS-independent “truth position” of aircraft, AireonVECTOR empowers aviation stakeholders with the
insight needed to monitor, mitigate, and respond to navigation threats.

[Learn more][46]

## The Aireon Difference

Since 2019, the aviation industry has trusted Aireon to provide its high-fidelity global dataset to
enable the safe and efficient management of aircraft. Powered by Iridium’s networked constellation
of 66 satellites, Aireon ADS-B provides continuous air traffic surveillance to areas of the world
that previously had no access to this information, including over oceans, polar regions, mountainous
regions, jungles, deserts, and conflicted airspace.

[Our Technology][47]

### Join us in revolutionizing air traffic surveillance

Our game-changing data and products are driven by our passionate and hardworking team who work to
make aviation safer and more efficient everyday. Aireon embodies a culture that is customer-centric,
safety-minded, mission critical, and ethical.

[Explore our careers][48]

## Aireon is the pioneer of space-based automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) data for
## the aviation industry

Aireon’s one-of-a-kind ADS-B data stream is bringing unprecedented levels of safety, efficiency, and
environmental responsibility to a wide range of customers in the aviation industry, including air
navigation service providers, airlines, airport operators, airframe manufacturers, system
integrators, and military and intelligence agencies.

With its portfolio of diverse products, Aireon is enabling new levels of insight into air operations
around the globe, leading to more data-driven decision making.

[About us][41]

## Our products combine the highest quality data with valuable insights

ATS Surveillance AireonSTREAM AireonFLOW AireonINSIGHTS AireonVECTOR
[ATS Surveillance]

#### Safety-grade data for navigation

Aireon has deployed the first-of-its-kind air traffic surveillance system, and the Aireon data has
quickly become the gold-standard for ANSPs around the world to safely manage their airspaces.

[Learn more][42]
[AireonSTREAM]

#### Tailored, streaming data

AireonSTREAM provides global, gate-to-gate, surface-to-space ATS surveillance quality data, combined
with contextual flight and airspace information, including infrastructure, weather, avionics,
aircraft registry, and schedule data.

[Learn more][43]
[AireonFLOW]

#### Real-time data for traffic flow management

AireonFLOW is gate-to-gate, high- fidelity Air Traffic Services (ATS) surveillance data combined
with flight and airspace contextual information. Combined, this enhances prediction capabilities of
flow management and demand platforms.

[Learn more][44]
[AireonINSIGHTS]

#### Event-based flight information

AireonINSIGHTS family of products — including Aireon Locate — put the power of our dataset into your
hands. Whether you are a first responder needing to locate an aircraft with Aireon Locate or an
operator wanting to ensure the integrity of the GPS signal in your airspace, AireonINSIGHTS is there
for you.

[Learn more][45]
[AireonVECTOR photo]

#### Real-time GPS interference detection

AireonVECTOR is a suite of products that uses Aireon’s space-based ADS-B data to detect and
visualize GPS interference—such as jamming and spoofing—in real time. By generating a
GPS-independent “truth position” of aircraft, AireonVECTOR empowers aviation stakeholders with the
insight needed to monitor, mitigate, and respond to navigation threats.

[Learn more][46]

## The Aireon Difference

Since 2019, the aviation industry has trusted Aireon to provide its high-fidelity global dataset to
enable the safe and efficient management of aircraft. Powered by Iridium’s networked constellation
of 66 satellites, Aireon ADS-B provides continuous air traffic surveillance to areas of the world
that previously had no access to this information, including over oceans, polar regions, mountainous
regions, jungles, deserts, and conflicted airspace.

Our game-changing data and products are driven by our passionate and hardworking team who work to
make aviation safer and more efficient everyday. Aireon embodies a culture that is customer-centric,
safety-minded, mission critical, and ethical.

# Live Flight Tracker - Unfiltered ADS-B and MLAT Aircraft Tracking

[Airplanes.live ADS-B MLAT map screenshot]
[Airplanes.live ADS-B Global heat map screenshot]

## What is Airplanes.live?

Airplanes.live is a community-driven ADS-B aggregator dedicated to aviation enthusiasts. It
leverages enthusiast receivers to capture ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast) and
MLAT (Multilateration) data, providing real-time information about aircraft in your area. Your
unfiltered data allows enthusiasts, researchers, and journalists access to an incredible amount of
data related to flight monitoring.

Airplanes.live will never filter or obfuscate aircraft data. Unfiltered and Unobfuscated MLAT is
also transmitted back to each [feeder][22] sending data to Airplanes.live.

Whether you're a plane spotter or simply curious about the skies above, Airplanes.live offers a
unique perspective on air traffic, making it a valuable resource for aviation enthusiasts and
curious individuals alike.

Use Airplanes.live as your free live flight tracker: follow global air traffic, watch military
aircraft that many flight radar sites filter out, and track any plane in real time on the live map.

El mundo moderno está en proceso de progreso total, incluido el progreso tecnológico. Hoy en día,
cada uno tiene una computadora o teléfono inteligente que hacen la vida mucho más fácil. Un buen
ejemplo de progreso es la capacidad de rastrear aviones durante el vuelo. El proceso de seguimiento
de aviones se hizo posible gracias a la tecnología de seguimiento de vuelos.

Cuando los aviones están en el aire, los que controlan air traffic en un aeropuerto monitorean sus
vuelos. Necesitan ajustar la salida y la llegada de algún avión. Para los usuarios simples, es
suficiente estar convencido de que el movimiento del avión que lleva a sus familiares y amigos es
exitoso. En este caso nos ayudan los servicios web de radar convenientes y fáciles de usar que hacen
posible seguir los vuelos en directo.

El rastreo por medio de un radar sólo es posible si el avión tiene un localizador de los vuelos tal
como ADS-B instalado.

[Flightradars24 – localizador de vuelos]

Si es posible obtener datos de recursos de Internet especializados, el radar también puede
proporcionar información sobre el tipo del avión, determinar a qué compañía de transporte pertenece,
indicar el punto de salida y llegada, etc. El radar de los vuelos almacena todos los datos de vuelo
de los últimos veintiocho días.

Se puede utilizar un radar mediante una computadora personal, computadora portátil, tableta o
teléfono inteligente.

## Le ayudamos con su problema de vuelo 

¿Vuelo cancelado o retrasado? Le apoyamos con todo tipo de problemas de vuelo y reclamamos su
compensación. Incluso hasta 5 años retroactivamente.

### ********Retraso de vuelo** ******

Si su vuelo se retrasa 3 horas o más, podría tener derecho a compensación bajo la ley de la UE.

### ********Cancelación de vuelo********

Si su vuelo se cancela con poca antelación, podría tener derecho a compensación bajo la ley de la
UE. Si no recibe un vuelo de reemplazo, también puede reclamar el [reembolso][158] del billete. 

### **Vuelo de conexión perdido** 

Tiene derecho a compensación si pierde un [vuelo de conexión][159] sin que sea su culpa y llega a su
destino final con un retraso de 3 horas o más. 

### ******Reprogramación de vuelo******

Si su vuelo es reprogramado, puede reclamar el reembolso completo del billete. Si su vuelo es
reprogramado para otro día con poca antelación (14 días o menos antes de la salida), podría tener
derecho a compensación. 

### **Retraso de vuelo** 

Si su vuelo se retrasa 3 horas o más, podría tener derecho a compensación bajo la ley de la UE. 

### ********Cancelación de vuelo** ******

Si su vuelo se cancela con poca antelación, podría tener derecho a compensación bajo la ley de la

  used by potential advertisers or investors.

  visitor.

[ What is siteprice.org? ][30]
siteprice.org is a free website worth, domain value & domain worth calculator, website traffic
checker, website statistics and website ranking checker tool. siteprice.org helps you to find your
or competitors' website price and website valuation, estimated approximate website traffic, value of
website/domain.
siteprice.org estimates the website price(not the business price) with using several information
with gathering, collecting and analyzing data from internet resources.

To estimate the worth of a website and valuation of websites, siteprice.org calculates with its own
unique algorithm.

Try our [**website traffic checker**][31] free online tool to check website traffic analysis and
website traffic estimation.
If you want to sell your website or buy a website you'll probably need to know the website value and
domain name value and appraise it.

Maybe your domain or website worths thousands. Maybe you don't even think about to sell your
website, but don't miss your chance, calculate estimated website price or your domain value and put
it into your site to catch somebody who may want to interest with your web site.

[Similar sites like][32] is a free tool to find websites similar, alternatives or related to a given
site. It helps you to find similar sites based on keyword overlap and shared audience.

How does siteprice.org calculate and estimate website worth or value of a domain?

siteprice.org algorithm KPIs are based on to calculate the value of a website;
* estimated daily unique view(which is maybe the most important factor). Estimated daily unique
  visitors count is trying to be estimated with several sources like [Alexa][33], Compete, Google Ad
  Planner etc... It is not %100 correct but with our tests it is very proximate for most of the
  websites. Unique user count is a common way of measuring the popularity of a website and is often
  used by potential advertisers or investors.
* daily pageview,
* estimated daily advertisement income(which will help to indicate the logical price of the domain).
  Daily Advertisement Revenue calculation is based on Adsense income. Today most of the webmasters
  use Google Adsense. Our estimation is trying to emulate for a better adsense usage if this website
  uses 3 adsense ads on all pages. It is not easy to calculate for different keywords because
  adsense can show an ad not related only the page content, adsense can choose a specific ad for
  visitor.
* alexa rank. Alexa is one of the most common website tracker. It measures sites traffic and
  compares all other websites traffic. It helps webmasters and advertisers to see the true marketing
  potential of website. Unfortunately it doesn't give always correct values because of
  manipulations. But it is still the most trustable tracker. And without alexa rank values it is
  hard to estimate a domain value.
* Expired... domain google pagerank. Google pagerank is one of the most determining factor for a
  website quality today. And getting a high PR value is not an easy task. It requires lots of
  quality work. So Google pagerank value is an important factor for site price worth calculation.
  PageRank affects the number of pages of a website that get indexed by Google. So basically if you
  want more visitors with getting more pages indexed you have to increase PageRank. So we are using
  pagerank in our **domain appraisal** algorithm too.
* search engines google,yahoo and bing index status. The more pages that search engines index, the
  better. Search engines access websites to crawl site content and index some of the pages to their
  databases. They might don't index all the pages you have, mostly index pages with quality and
  unique content. So Indexing is one of the hardest factor if you have a big website, so we believe
  that search engine visibility is very important calculating the website value. If you have lots of
  pages indexed means that your domain has a lot possibility visited by my more visitors.
* domain age(which is important ranking factor for search engines). Domain age is an important SEO
  factor for search engines rankings because search engines use it for calculation trust and
  authority. Another thing is that spammers register and drop domains quickly, so spamming sites
  usually have newly registered domain names. But indexing of the site is more important from domain
  age.
* social media visibility, share count of your site on social media shows that your site has quality
  content(facebook, twitter, google+),
* backlink count(backlinks mean that links count that point to your domain from other websites and
  it's like a popularity rating for your site. google,yahoo,bing,alexa and total external backlink
  count. Low but quality backlinks are better than high but poor quality backlinks. So this value
  has a lower impact in our site price calculation algorithm. Backlinks are very related with Google
  pagerank so we believe that PR value is more important from backlink count.)
Note that if your website or domain is rather new, it won't be easy to make an accurate estimation
because of less resources to check your domain.

# Understanding AMOS

Designed by Swiss AviationSoftware (Swiss-AS) based on more than 35 years of experience in aviation
software, AMOS is a comprehensive aircraft maintenance and engineering system trusted by airlines
and MRO providers worldwide. Developed in close collaboration with the aviation community, AMOS
supports maintenance, engineering and logistics processes across the entire operation while ensuring
full regulatory compliance.

Suitable for organisations of all sizes, AMOS combines functional depth with ease of use and
integrates seamlessly into existing IT landscapes. As an industry-leading, future-ready platform,
customers benefit from higher efficiency, better reliability and faster digital transformation.

[Live Demo][51]
[Order AMOS brochure][52]

## Key benefits

01

### End-to-end integration

Maintenance, engineering and logistics processes are connected in one system.

02

### Built-in regulatory compliance

Designed to support full airworthiness and audit readiness at all times.

03

### Flexible and scalable

Configurable for different operators, fleets and business models.

04

### Seamless ecosystem connectivity

Open interfaces enable easy integration with existing systems and partners.

05

### Digital and paperless workflows

Mobile solutions support real-time execution at the aircraft and in the office.

06

### Proven in global operations

Trusted by hundreds of organisations across five continents.

[ [plane] ][53]

## Your gateway to seamless digital transformation

AMOS is intuitive, easy to integrate and rich in functionality. Developed by an airline for
airlines, it enables customers to make operations productive and evolve processes over time.
Deployed worldwide, AMOS supports complex maintenance and engineering environments without
compromising usability. Customers retain full ownership of their data and benefit from an open
system architecture that ensures operational autonomy. Based on decades of continuous development,
AMOS provides a stable foundation for long-term digital transformation across aviation maintenance
and engineering.

[Learn more][54]

## Services

Swiss-AS supports customers across the entire AMOS lifecycle. From implementation and training to
ongoing operations and optimisation, our services ensure long-term success and strong system
performance.

[See more][55]
[Wing_Plane]

## Customers

AMOS is trusted by airlines, MRO providers and aviation organisations worldwide. Close collaboration
with customers ensures continuous development aligned with real operational needs.

[See our customers][56]

## Ecosystem

AMOS is part of a broader Digital Tech Ops Ecosystem that connects maintenance systems, analytics
and digital records through secure interfaces for seamless integration across the organisation.

[Explore the ecosystem][57]
[Plane_Maintance]

## Technology

AMOS runs on a modern, secure and future-ready technology stack with regular releases, high
availability and flexible deployment options to ensure long-term stability and regulatory alignment.

[Explore the technology][58]

committed to sharing data and providing an opportunity for others to learn from it. TheAirTraffic

easy to use flight tracking websites and combine it with the ability to track any aircraft. Then

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about WA Sender

Is WA Sender safe to use? Will my WhatsApp account get banned?

WA Sender is designed with safety in mind. Our smart delay system, batch sending, and gradual volume
increase features help protect your account. We recommend following WhatsApp's guidelines and
avoiding spam messages.

What's the difference between the plans?

All plans include the full WA Sender software with unlimited features. The Personal plan is for
individual use. The Reseller plan adds an unlimited online panel to generate licenses for your
clients. The Distributor plan lets you create multiple resellers, each with their own panel.

Do I need to save contacts before sending messages?

No! WA Sender allows you to send messages to unsaved numbers directly. Simply import your contact
list from CSV/Excel or paste the numbers, and you're ready to go.

Is this a one-time payment?

Yes! All our plans are anuallicenses with one-time payment. No monthly fees, no hidden costs. You
pay once and use forever, including all future updates.

Can I send media files with messages?

Yes! WA Sender supports sending images, videos, documents, and audio files. You can attach media to
make your messages more engaging and informative.

What are the benefits of online check-in?

airport. While online check-in is offered by almost every airline, you should always double-check
that your travel documents are in order before booking flights.
Is web check-in necessary?
it is mandatory to web check-in for your domestic flight. Complete it for free 48 hr to 60 min
before your domestic flight and 24 hr to 75 min before your international flight. It is mandatory

it easy for users to find up-to-date information on flights, and also keeps them up to date on the
latest changes.

# The Essential App for Aviation

Individual pilots and professional flight crews across the world depend on ForeFlight's integrated
flight app to make flying safer, easier, and more efficient.

# General Aviation

Designed by pilots for pilots, ForeFlight delivers personal aviators an all-in-one solution for
flight planning, checklists, charts, weather, airport information, flight logging, document
management, hazard awareness, and more.

[Learn More][71]

# Business Aviation

Maximize the efficiency and safety of your flight operation by utilizing ForeFlight's seamlessly
integrated data, software and services - all specifically designed for optimal performance and
usability.

[Maximize Your Flight Operations][72]

# Military Aviation

ForeFlight provides the world’s best pilots with everything they need to keep their operations
informed, organized, and in sync.

## About Me

I'm Aayan, a technically inclined developer with experience across flight tracking systems,
hardware, and game development. I'm not a full-time developer, but I'm learning and want to learn. I
can help with aviation-related projects and enjoy working at the intersection of technology and my
interests.

### Flight Tracking Systems

I've built and maintained a full ADS-B receiver setup using Docker containers, aggregating live
aircraft data and feeding it to multiple flight-tracking platforms including FlightRadar24,
FlightAware, and other major networks.

### Hardware & Aviation

I've built Stratux-style systems for my Private Pilot License training. It's a straightforward build
that anyone can do, but it's been useful for understanding aviation workflows and data usage.

### ROBLOX Development

I work with ROBLOX Studio, mainly creating basic airport layouts, taxiways, and markings. I
understand how airports operate and how taxi diagrams are structured, which helps with the modeling
work.

### Technical Skills

I'm a beginner-to-intermediate coder with experience in systems thinking. My strongest skill set is
technical problem-solving and hardware: I regularly work with and repair electronics including DJI
drones, phones, laptops, and other devices.

### Photography

I do some occasional photography with a Sony A7Riii, exploring aviation and other subjects through
the lens.

## Every Pilot Has These Problems

AeroCopilot solves the pain points that keep pilots up at night -- and the ones they forget about
until it matters.

### Forgot to check your medical?

AeroCopilot tracks every expiration -- medical, BFR, IFR currency, 90-day landings -- and alerts you
before it matters.

### Can't decode that METAR?

The AI reads every coded weather report and explains it in plain English. KJFK 241456Z 27015G25KT
becomes "Winds from west at 15 gusting 25, visibility excellent."

### Birds near your airport?

We track FAA wildlife strike data by airport and season. Know the risk before you fly.

### Is your GPS reliable today?

Space weather affects GPS/WAAS accuracy. We monitor NOAA solar data and alert you when Kp index
affects navigation.

### Smoke on your route?

NOAA satellite detection shows active smoke plumes along your planned route. See what no other app
shows.

### 3,000+ weather cameras, decoded by AI

See real conditions at 924 FAA camera sites. Our AI identifies visibility, ceiling, and hazards from
the images.

## Aireon is the pioneer of space-based automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) data for
## the aviation industry

Aireon’s one-of-a-kind ADS-B data stream is bringing unprecedented levels of safety, efficiency, and
environmental responsibility to a wide range of customers in the aviation industry, including air
navigation service providers, airlines, airport operators, airframe manufacturers, system
integrators, and military and intelligence agencies.

With its portfolio of diverse products, Aireon is enabling new levels of insight into air operations
around the globe, leading to more data-driven decision making.

[About us][41]

## Our products combine the highest quality data with valuable insights

ATS Surveillance AireonSTREAM AireonFLOW AireonINSIGHTS AireonVECTOR
[ATS Surveillance]

#### Safety-grade data for navigation

Aireon has deployed the first-of-its-kind air traffic surveillance system, and the Aireon data has
quickly become the gold-standard for ANSPs around the world to safely manage their airspaces.

[Learn more][42]
[AireonSTREAM]

#### Tailored, streaming data

AireonSTREAM provides global, gate-to-gate, surface-to-space ATS surveillance quality data, combined
with contextual flight and airspace information, including infrastructure, weather, avionics,
aircraft registry, and schedule data.

[Learn more][43]
[AireonFLOW]

#### Real-time data for traffic flow management

AireonFLOW is gate-to-gate, high- fidelity Air Traffic Services (ATS) surveillance data combined
with flight and airspace contextual information. Combined, this enhances prediction capabilities of
flow management and demand platforms.

[Learn more][44]
[AireonINSIGHTS]

#### Event-based flight information

AireonINSIGHTS family of products — including Aireon Locate — put the power of our dataset into your
hands. Whether you are a first responder needing to locate an aircraft with Aireon Locate or an
operator wanting to ensure the integrity of the GPS signal in your airspace, AireonINSIGHTS is there
for you.

[Learn more][45]
[AireonVECTOR photo]

#### Real-time GPS interference detection

AireonVECTOR is a suite of products that uses Aireon’s space-based ADS-B data to detect and
visualize GPS interference—such as jamming and spoofing—in real time. By generating a
GPS-independent “truth position” of aircraft, AireonVECTOR empowers aviation stakeholders with the
insight needed to monitor, mitigate, and respond to navigation threats.

[Learn more][46]

## The Aireon Difference

Since 2019, the aviation industry has trusted Aireon to provide its high-fidelity global dataset to
enable the safe and efficient management of aircraft. Powered by Iridium’s networked constellation
of 66 satellites, Aireon ADS-B provides continuous air traffic surveillance to areas of the world
that previously had no access to this information, including over oceans, polar regions, mountainous
regions, jungles, deserts, and conflicted airspace.

[Our Technology][47]

### Join us in revolutionizing air traffic surveillance

Our game-changing data and products are driven by our passionate and hardworking team who work to
make aviation safer and more efficient everyday. Aireon embodies a culture that is customer-centric,
safety-minded, mission critical, and ethical.

[Explore our careers][48]

# Live Flight Tracker - Unfiltered ADS-B and MLAT Aircraft Tracking

[Airplanes.live ADS-B MLAT map screenshot]
[Airplanes.live ADS-B Global heat map screenshot]

## What is Airplanes.live?

Airplanes.live is a community-driven ADS-B aggregator dedicated to aviation enthusiasts. It
leverages enthusiast receivers to capture ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast) and
MLAT (Multilateration) data, providing real-time information about aircraft in your area. Your
unfiltered data allows enthusiasts, researchers, and journalists access to an incredible amount of
data related to flight monitoring.

Airplanes.live will never filter or obfuscate aircraft data. Unfiltered and Unobfuscated MLAT is
also transmitted back to each [feeder][22] sending data to Airplanes.live.

Whether you're a plane spotter or simply curious about the skies above, Airplanes.live offers a
unique perspective on air traffic, making it a valuable resource for aviation enthusiasts and
curious individuals alike.

Use Airplanes.live as your free live flight tracker: follow global air traffic, watch military
aircraft that many flight radar sites filter out, and track any plane in real time on the live map.

## What is Airplanes.live?

Airplanes.live is a community-driven ADS-B aggregator dedicated to aviation enthusiasts. It
leverages enthusiast receivers to capture ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast) and
MLAT (Multilateration) data, providing real-time information about aircraft in your area. Your
unfiltered data allows enthusiasts, researchers, and journalists access to an incredible amount of
data related to flight monitoring.

Airplanes.live will never filter or obfuscate aircraft data. Unfiltered and Unobfuscated MLAT is
also transmitted back to each [feeder][22] sending data to Airplanes.live.

Whether you're a plane spotter or simply curious about the skies above, Airplanes.live offers a
unique perspective on air traffic, making it a valuable resource for aviation enthusiasts and
curious individuals alike.

Use Airplanes.live as your free live flight tracker: follow global air traffic, watch military
aircraft that many flight radar sites filter out, and track any plane in real time on the live map.

# Seguimiento de Vuelos en Tiempo Real Gratis

### [Flightradar24: Seguimiento de Vuelos en Tiempo Real][95]

[[FlightAware – Seguimiento de vuelos]][96]

### [RadarBox24 – el radar para rastrear aviones 24/7][99]

### [Plane Finder – uno de más populares radares de vuelos en vivo][100]

[[RadarVirtuel – servicio para observar vuelos]][101]

### [RadarVirtuel — la observación de los aviones en el régimen online][102]

[[CasperFlights]][103]

### [CasperFlights — el radar europeo para el rastreo de los aviones][104]

El mundo moderno está en proceso de progreso total, incluido el progreso tecnológico. Hoy en día,
cada uno tiene una computadora o teléfono inteligente que hacen la vida mucho más fácil. Un buen
ejemplo de progreso es la capacidad de rastrear aviones durante el vuelo. El proceso de seguimiento
de aviones se hizo posible gracias a la tecnología de seguimiento de vuelos.

Cuando los aviones están en el aire, los que controlan air traffic en un aeropuerto monitorean sus
vuelos. Necesitan ajustar la salida y la llegada de algún avión. Para los usuarios simples, es
suficiente estar convencido de que el movimiento del avión que lleva a sus familiares y amigos es
exitoso. En este caso nos ayudan los servicios web de radar convenientes y fáciles de usar que hacen
posible seguir los vuelos en directo.

El rastreo por medio de un radar sólo es posible si el avión tiene un localizador de los vuelos tal
como ADS-B instalado.

[Flightradars24 – localizador de vuelos]

Si es posible obtener datos de recursos de Internet especializados, el radar también puede
proporcionar información sobre el tipo del avión, determinar a qué compañía de transporte pertenece,
indicar el punto de salida y llegada, etc. El radar de los vuelos almacena todos los datos de vuelo
de los últimos veintiocho días.

Se puede utilizar un radar mediante una computadora personal, computadora portátil, tableta o
teléfono inteligente.

## Todos radares de vuelos en un sitio

Flightradars24.es es un recurso de Internet que permite a todos seguir los vuelos online. La
información general sobre el sitio se ofrece en español. La audiencia de los usuarios de los
recursos son aficionados a los viajes y todos los que desean observar cómo se mueven los aviones

El mundo moderno está en proceso de progreso total, incluido el progreso tecnológico. Hoy en día,
cada uno tiene una computadora o teléfono inteligente que hacen la vida mucho más fácil. Un buen
ejemplo de progreso es la capacidad de rastrear aviones durante el vuelo. El proceso de seguimiento
de aviones se hizo posible gracias a la tecnología de seguimiento de vuelos.

Cuando los aviones están en el aire, los que controlan air traffic en un aeropuerto monitorean sus
vuelos. Necesitan ajustar la salida y la llegada de algún avión. Para los usuarios simples, es
suficiente estar convencido de que el movimiento del avión que lleva a sus familiares y amigos es
exitoso. En este caso nos ayudan los servicios web de radar convenientes y fáciles de usar que hacen
posible seguir los vuelos en directo.

El rastreo por medio de un radar sólo es posible si el avión tiene un localizador de los vuelos tal
como ADS-B instalado.

[Flightradars24 – localizador de vuelos]

Si es posible obtener datos de recursos de Internet especializados, el radar también puede
proporcionar información sobre el tipo del avión, determinar a qué compañía de transporte pertenece,
indicar el punto de salida y llegada, etc. El radar de los vuelos almacena todos los datos de vuelo
de los últimos veintiocho días.

Se puede utilizar un radar mediante una computadora personal, computadora portátil, tableta o
teléfono inteligente.

## Todos radares de vuelos en un sitio

Flightradars24.es es un recurso de Internet que permite a todos seguir los vuelos online. La
información general sobre el sitio se ofrece en español. La audiencia de los usuarios de los
recursos son aficionados a los viajes y todos los que desean observar cómo se mueven los aviones
cuando envían o encuentran a los pasajeros y el equipaje.

El sitio contiene todos los radares online más populares, funcionales y precisos que hacen posible
el rastreo de los vuelos en tiempo real. El recurso ofrece la posibilidad de analizar las
características comparativas de los radares online existentes y elegir el radar que le conviene más.
En Flightradars24.es, se puede conocer la información sobre los principios del funcionamiento de los
radares, sus tipos y aprender a usarlos de manera correcta y efectiva.

**delays can occur due to various factors** like customs processing or temporary logistic issues.

However, if you believe there might be an issue, the next course of action is to **contact the
shipping carrier or the sender**. They will have more specific information about the package's
current status and might be able to provide insights or initiate inquiries on your behalf.

packages are misrouted or held up due to address issues, so verifying the address details you

# Что умеет SkyMoments AI

Первый в мире специализированный ИИ по авиации. Некоторые возможности пока в разработке, но скоро
всё будет!
* Отвечает на любые вопросы про гражданскую авиацию — быстро, чётко и без воды
* Объясняет термины простым языком — без Википедии и занудства
* Помогает разобраться в Airbus, Boeing, аэропортах, ливреях и не только
* Пересказывает статьи, новости и обзоры на сайте — в любом стиле, как вам удобно
* Дает и расшифровывает METAR, TAF и прочие погодные коды — понятно и по делу
* Подстраивает стиль общения — может быть строгим, дружелюбным или вообще материться, если надо

# О SkyMoments

SkyMoments — независимый проект о гражданской авиации. Мы искренне любим её и рассказываем о ней
подробно и понятно.

На сайте мы публикуем большие статьи обо всём в гражданской авиации. Пишем так, чтобы тема стала
ясна целиком.

Каждый день в нашем телеграм-канале выходят новости и короткие разборы по рубрикам. На сайте новости
публикуются реже, но глубже.

Развиваем Altair — собственного ИИ-ассистента по гражданской авиации. Учим его отвечать на вопросы
об авиации точно и по делу.

Наша главная задача — чтобы на SkyMoments можно было найти понятный ответ на любой вопрос о
гражданской авиации.

# Understanding AMOS

Designed by Swiss AviationSoftware (Swiss-AS) based on more than 35 years of experience in aviation
software, AMOS is a comprehensive aircraft maintenance and engineering system trusted by airlines
and MRO providers worldwide. Developed in close collaboration with the aviation community, AMOS
supports maintenance, engineering and logistics processes across the entire operation while ensuring
full regulatory compliance.

Suitable for organisations of all sizes, AMOS combines functional depth with ease of use and
integrates seamlessly into existing IT landscapes. As an industry-leading, future-ready platform,
customers benefit from higher efficiency, better reliability and faster digital transformation.

[Live Demo][51]
[Order AMOS brochure][52]

## Key benefits

01

### End-to-end integration

Maintenance, engineering and logistics processes are connected in one system.

02

### Built-in regulatory compliance

Designed to support full airworthiness and audit readiness at all times.

03

### Flexible and scalable

Configurable for different operators, fleets and business models.

04

### Seamless ecosystem connectivity

Open interfaces enable easy integration with existing systems and partners.

05

### Digital and paperless workflows

Mobile solutions support real-time execution at the aircraft and in the office.

06

### Proven in global operations

Trusted by hundreds of organisations across five continents.

AMOS is intuitive, easy to integrate and rich in functionality. Developed by an airline for
airlines, it enables customers to make operations productive and evolve processes over time.
Deployed worldwide, AMOS supports complex maintenance and engineering environments without
compromising usability. Customers retain full ownership of their data and benefit from an open
system architecture that ensures operational autonomy. Based on decades of continuous development,
AMOS provides a stable foundation for long-term digital transformation across aviation maintenance
and engineering.

[Learn more][54]

## Services

Swiss-AS supports customers across the entire AMOS lifecycle. From implementation and training to
ongoing operations and optimisation, our services ensure long-term success and strong system
performance.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about WA Sender

Is WA Sender safe to use? Will my WhatsApp account get banned?

WA Sender is designed with safety in mind. Our smart delay system, batch sending, and gradual volume
increase features help protect your account. We recommend following WhatsApp's guidelines and
avoiding spam messages.

What's the difference between the plans?

All plans include the full WA Sender software with unlimited features. The Personal plan is for
individual use. The Reseller plan adds an unlimited online panel to generate licenses for your
clients. The Distributor plan lets you create multiple resellers, each with their own panel.

Do I need to save contacts before sending messages?

No! WA Sender allows you to send messages to unsaved numbers directly. Simply import your contact
list from CSV/Excel or paste the numbers, and you're ready to go.

Is this a one-time payment?

Yes! All our plans are anuallicenses with one-time payment. No monthly fees, no hidden costs. You
pay once and use forever, including all future updates.

Can I send media files with messages?

Yes! WA Sender supports sending images, videos, documents, and audio files. You can attach media to
make your messages more engaging and informative.

### Frequently Asked Questions

What is WebCheckin.Info?
We are pleased to announce that you can now check your flights quick services via WebCheckin.Info.
This way, you'll save time and won't have to go through the hassle of checking in at different
airports throughout your journey.
Why choose WebCheckin.Info for airline quick services?
WebCheckin.Info is the best and easiest way to checkin for flights on your mobile browser for all
airlines worldwide including IndiGo, Air India, Akasa Airlines, Vistara, Spice Jet and so on.
WebCheckin.Info is the future of airport web check-in.
What are the benefits of online check-in?
Online check-in allows travelers to confirm their personal details and reduces wait time at the
airport. While online check-in is offered by almost every airline, you should always double-check
that your travel documents are in order before booking flights.
Is web check-in necessary?
it is mandatory to web check-in for your domestic flight. Complete it for free 48 hr to 60 min
before your domestic flight and 24 hr to 75 min before your international flight. It is mandatory
for all passengers to check-in online 48 hours to 60 min before flight departure.
Why choose WebCheckin.Info for check flight updates?
Web check-in.info is a leading online travel site that offers users check flight updates. This makes
it easy for users to find up-to-date information on flights, and also keeps them up to date on the
latest changes.
